question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list in time order the occasions on which the class was given new locomotive numbers or a new number range by a company-wide arrangement, such as the LNER grouping, the renumbering schemes, or the renumbering at nationalisation.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn mốc đánh số lại của cùng lớp đầu máy nằm ở các chunk khác nhau (grouping, hai scheme, nationalisation).
criterion: The class was given new locomotive numbers or allocated a new number range by a company-wide arrangement (LNER grouping, renumbering scheme, or nationalisation renumbering).

label: modification
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list in time order the dates on which work began on each of these changes to the class's locomotives: fitting of vacuum ejectors, fitting of ACFI feedwater heaters, fitting of Lenz poppet valves, reversion to piston valves, the rebuilding programme with larger boilers, and removal of the feedwater heaters.
why_needs_multiple: Sáu chương trình thay đổi khác nhau, mỗi chương trình lấy mốc bắt đầu; e11 mang label rebuild, các mốc còn lại label modification.
criterion: The start of one of six named modification or rebuilding programmes on the class: vacuum ejector fitting, ACFI feedwater heater fitting, Lenz poppet valve fitting, reversion to piston valves, boiler rebuilding programme, ACFI heater removal.

label: modification
question: How many years passed between the start of fitting vacuum ejectors to the class's locomotives and the end of that fitting?
why_needs_multiple: Hai mốc đầu và cuối của cùng một đợt lắp vacuum ejector, tách biệt ở hai chunk (1924 và 1929).

label: rebuild
question: How many years passed between the start of the programme to rebuild the class with larger boilers and the rebuild of the last locomotive in that programme?
why_needs_multiple: Mốc bắt đầu chương trình và mốc kết thúc (locomotive cuối cùng được rebuild) nằm ở cùng một chunk nhưng là hai sự kiện.

question: How many years passed between the start of the transfers of the class to Scotland and the end of those transfers?
why_needs_multiple: Hai mốc đầu và cuối của đợt chuyển 25 đầu máy sang Scotland (1931 và 1942).
